title: model version source URI parsing: only a single-segment models:/<model_id> without @ is treated as a logged model source in the UI
answers: Which model version sources does the UI treat as a logged model, and why does a models:/name/version source not show Source Model?
A version was registered with an alias URI like models:/name@alias. Why is there no Source Model row?
Where does the UI parse the models:/ source string on the model version page?
body:
Path: The model version page reads the source URI of a registered model version (for example models:/<name>/<version>, models:/<name>@<alias>, models:/<model_id> or mlflow-artifacts:/ paths). extractLoggedModelIdFromModelSource in mlflow/server/js/src/model-registry/utils/VersionUtils.ts decides whether the source is a logged model, and ModelVersionViewImpl uses it to choose between the Source Model row and the Copied from link.
Rule: extractLoggedModelIdFromModelSource matches /^models:\/([^/@]+)$/ and returns the capture, so only a single path segment with no '@' counts as a model ID. This mirrors _parse_model_uri on the Python client. Any change to how the Python client parses models:/ URIs must be reflected in this regex together with the VersionUtils.test.ts cases.
Constraints: Returns undefined for undefined input, for models:/<name>/<version>, for models:/<name>@<alias>, and for mlflow-artifacts paths; those keep the existing Copied from behavior. Do not widen the regex to accept multi-segment or alias forms without also changing the Copied from branch, or the same source would render two rows.
applies: Parsing of model version source URIs for the Model Registry UI in the MLflow OSS frontend; applies when changing which source forms get a logged model link.
says: The model version page shows Copied from instead of Source Model for aliased versions.
Versions registered from another model version do not display the source model details row.
Why does the model details screen show Copied from for versions created with aliases?
Make the model version view link directly to the source model for alias paths.
search: In the MLflow Model Registry UI, extractLoggedModelIdFromModelSource in mlflow/server/js/src/model-registry/utils/VersionUtils.ts matches /^models:\/([^/@]+)$/ so only a single path segment without an '@' is treated as a logged model ID for ModelVersionViewImpl. Multi-segment paths like models:/<name>/<version>, alias URIs like models:/<name>@<alias>, and mlflow-artifacts:/ paths return undefined and retain the Copied from behavior. Any change mirroring Python client _parse_model_uri parsing must update this regex, VersionUtils.test.ts, and the Copied from branch to avoid rendering two rows.
